claim: A door receipt the server refuses for good (isPermanentRefusal: any 4xx other than 401/408/425/429) is PARKED as not sent, never dropped (ADR 0241 amendment 2026-09-29; the founder, verbatim: "option 1, not sent. but we have to find a way to optimizew storage using per device? what sindustry equilavent" - the storage half is a following amendment). doorOutbox runFlush parks it with updatePendingMutation(lastError, parked refused+status) and its refusal branch neither deletes the entry nor writes an ADR 0140 drop record (recordDrop is gone); pendingDoorCount excludes parked entries; resendDoorReceipt and discardDoorReceipt are exported. DoorNext no longer tells a 403 drop it was signed out (says the account is not allowed, keep the paperwork, tell a manager), reads failed without subtracting dropped, and shows a quiet door:not-sent notice. The receiving rail renders a parked receipt as Not sent with Send again and Discard. syncManager.retryNotSent flushes the door and spot-count outboxes after un-parking. Behaviour: doorOutbox.test.ts, doorOutbox.durability.test.ts, DoorNext.test.tsx, ReceivingNext.test.tsx F12, sync-manager.test.ts (27/6/4/3/2 fail, re-measured by the ADR 0090 reviewer after the discard-scope test was added, on origin/main's doorOutbox/DoorNext/useReceivingNextData/RcOutboxRail/sync-manager). The verify pins the anchors; the specs are the behaviour.
